title: PBMC Extraction Protocol Using Iodixanol Density
author: Lily Johanna Toro
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kdmcs46
materials: Sln A: Optiprep: iodixanol 60% =1,32g/mL (agitar gentilmente antes de usar) Sln B: Hepes buffer salino= NaCL 0,85% p/v, Hepes 10mM – NaOH pH7,4. Para 50mL: pesar 0,425g de NaCl y 0,119g de Hepes diluir hasta 45mL y ajustar pH a 7,4 con NaOH (aprox 20-25µl 5M). llevar a 50ml y filtrar por 0.22µm. Barrera con densidad: 1,077g/mL = 5 Vlns Sln A + 17 Vlns Sln B 1,077g/mL = 2,5mL Sln A + 8,5mL Sln B= 11mL Medio de cultivo: 20 mL de medio RPMI 1640 con antibiótico antimicótico 1X. RPMI 1640 Medium Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #11875093 Optiprep ( Iodixanol) Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #D1556-250ML 10 mM HEPES (pH 7.5) Contributed by users 0.1 M NaOH Contributed by users A partir de 6mL de sangre se obtienen aproximadamente 8 millones de PBMCs. steps.title: Prepare blood sample
steps.instruction: Collect blood from a healthy patient using EDTA (1.5-2mM) and perform a 1:1 dilution with Solution B (e.g., add 3mL of Solution B to 3mL of blood).

steps.title: Perform density gradient centrifugation
steps.instruction: Layer the diluted sample over a density barrier to separate PBMCs.

substeps.instruction: Add 3 mL of density barrier (1.077g/mL) to a clean 15mL tube.
Very slowly add 6mL of the diluted sample on top of the barrier.
Centrifuge at 700g for 20 min at room temperature with the brake OFF.

steps.title: Collect PBMC interface
steps.instruction: Extract the interface layer using one of two methods.

substeps.instruction: Puncture the 15mL tube with a 21G syringe, keeping the bevel facing upwards
Alternatively, use a Pasteur pipette to collect the layer.

steps.title: Dilute and wash cells
steps.instruction: Dilute the collected cells 1:1 with Solution B.

steps.title: Remove excess platelets (Optional)
steps.instruction: Perform a wash step to remove excess platelets.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 150g for 10 min at room temperature.
Collect the pellet and resuspend it in approximately 2mL of RPMI with 1X antibiotic.

steps.title: Quantify PBMCs
steps.instruction: Determine cell concentration using a Neubauer chamber with a 1:16 dilution.

substeps.instruction: Perform serial dilutions with culture medium: 10µL RPMI + 10µL PBMCs (1:2), then 10µL of that + 10µL RPMI (1:4), then 10µL of that + 10µL RPMI (1:8).
Perform final dilution: 10µL of the 1:8 dilution + 10µL Trypan Blue (1:16).
Take 10µL and read in the chamber.
Calculate cells/mL using the formula: (total cells counted / 4) * 10,000 * 16.

steps.title: Seed cells
steps.instruction: Seed 200,000-250,000 PBMCs per well in a 96-well plate, or in T25 or T75 culture flasks.
